title: Who Writes the Codebook? An Eight-Step Framework for Auditing LLM-Generated Category Systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.19872v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly create the categories through which qualitative evidence is interpreted. Existing coding benchmarks often hold these categories fixed. We propose the Qualitative Variance Audit Framework, an eight-step method that compares codebook creation, repeated application and code distributions under controlled inputs. It combines model-owned and shared-reference codebooks to distinguish variation in the overall pipeline from application differences within a common category system. An application to 668 organisational interviews, 13,166 text units and eight models from five vendors yields 48 codebooks and 270 coding runs. Models create markedly different category structures; mean within-model reliability ranges from .76 to .92, whereas between-model agreement on the shared codebook is about .69. translated_title: 谁来编写编码手册？一个用于审计LLM生成类别系统的八步框架
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）日益承担起构建定性证据解读类别的任务，而现有编码基准测试通常将这些类别固定不变。我们提出定性差异审计框架，这是一种八步方法，可在受控输入条件下比较编码手册的创建、重复应用以及编码分布情况。该框架结合了模型自有的编码手册与共享参照编码手册，以区分整个流程中的差异与同一类别系统内应用层面的差异。将该框架应用于668份组织访谈、13,166个文本单元以及来自五家供应商的八个模型，共产生48套编码手册和270次编码运行。研究显示，各模型生成的类别结构差异显著：模型内部平均信度介于.76至.92之间，而模型间在共享编码手册上的一致性仅为约.69。该框架通过在实质性解读之前揭示模型依赖性，对LLM辅助的扎根理论方法形成了补充。
tldr: 该论文提出八步定性差异审计框架，通过对比模型自有与共享参照编码手册，揭示大语言模型生成的定性编码类别存在显著模型间差异（跨模型一致性仅约.69），从而在实质解读前审计模型依赖性。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes an eight-step Qualitative Variance Audit Framework that compares model-owned and shared-reference codebooks, revealing significant between-model differences in LLM-generated qualitative coding categories (only ~.69 cross-model agreement) to expose model dependencies before substantive interpretation.
